description_target.target_text: The four corners are transform keys for one central object. Remove the corner keys, crop the remaining object tightly, transform one copy according to each corner key (blue(1) → 90° clockwise, red(2) → 180°, green(3) → flip horizontal, yellow(4) → transpose), then assemble the four transformed copies into a 2×2 mosaic with one black(0) row and one black(0) column gap.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define dirs4-ordered (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (flat grid) (apply append grid))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-bbox-width obj) (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj))))
    (define (obj-bbox-height obj) (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj))))
    (define (bbox< a b)
      (if (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))
    (define (crop-nonzero grid)
      (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0)))
                           (grid-positions grid))))
        (if (empty? cells)
            (list (list 0))
            (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
                   (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
              (subgrid grid r0 c0 r1 c1)))))
    (define (component-grid obj)
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (obj-bbox-height obj) (obj-bbox-width obj) 0)])
                ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
        (set-cell out (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (obj-color obj))))
    (define (paste-crop grid shape top left)
      (for*/fold ([out grid])
                 ([r (in-range (rows shape))]
                  [c (in-range (cols shape))])
        (let ((v (at shape r c)) (rr (+ top r)) (cc (+ left c)))
          (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid)))
              (set-cell out rr cc v)
              out))))
    (define (binary-grid grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows grid) (cols grid) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at grid r c) 0) 0 1))))
    (define (shape-180-symmetric? shape)
      (equal? (binary-grid shape) (binary-grid (rotate-180 shape))))
    (define (transform-by-key shape key)
      (cond [(= key 1) (rotate-cw shape)]
            [(= key 2) (rotate-180 shape)]
            [(= key 3) (flip-lr shape)]
            [(= key 4) (transpose shape)]
            [else shape]))
    (define (apply-script shape tokens)
      (for/fold ([cur shape]) ([token (in-list tokens)])
        (transform-by-key cur token)))
    (define (pack-gallery shapes gap align)
      (let* ((h (if (empty? shapes) 1 (apply max (map rows shapes))))
             (w (if (empty? shapes) 1 (+ (apply + (map cols shapes)) (* gap (max 0 (- (length shapes) 1)))))))
        (let loop ([remaining shapes] [left 0] [out (empty-grid h w 0)])
          (if (empty? remaining)
              out
              (let* ((shape (first remaining))
                     (top (cond [(equal? align 'top) 0]
                                [(equal? align 'bottom) (- h (rows shape))]
                                [else (quotient (- h (rows shape)) 2)])))
                (loop (rest remaining) (+ left (cols shape) gap) (paste-crop out shape top left)))))))
    (define (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r1 c))
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r2 c))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c1))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c2)))))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj)) (c1 (obj-c1 obj)) (r2 (obj-r2 obj)) (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
             (cells (obj-cells obj))
             (expected (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2)))
        (and (>= (- r2 r1) 2)
             (>= (- c2 c1) 2)
             (= (length cells) (length expected))
             (all? (lambda (p) (member? p cells)) expected))))
    (define (center-in-frame shape frame)
      (let* ((ih (- (obj-r2 frame) (obj-r1 frame) 1))
             (iw (- (obj-c2 frame) (obj-c1 frame) 1))
             (top (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1 (quotient (- ih (rows shape)) 2)))
             (left (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1 (quotient (- iw (cols shape)) 2))))
        (list top left)))
    (define (shape-normal-binary shape)
      (binary-grid (crop-nonzero shape)))
    (define (pad-grid grid h w)
      (paste-crop (empty-grid h w 0) grid 0 0))
    (define (normalize-pair a b)
      (let* ((aa (shape-normal-binary a))
             (bb (shape-normal-binary b))
             (h (max (rows aa) (rows bb)))
             (w (max (cols aa) (cols bb))))
        (list (pad-grid aa h w) (pad-grid bb h w))))
    (define (rank-in precedence color)
      (let loop ([xs precedence] [i 0])
        (cond [(empty? xs) -1]
              [(= (first xs) color) i]
              [else (loop (rest xs) (+ i 1))])))
    (define (priority-overlay h w proposals precedence)
      (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid h w 0)])
                 ([r (in-range h)]
                  [c (in-range w)])
        (let ((hits (filter (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c))) proposals)))
          (if (empty? hits)
              out
              (let ((best (first (sort hits (lambda (a b) (> (rank-in precedence (third a)) (rank-in precedence (third b))))))))
                (set-cell out r c (third best)))))))
    (define (ray-cells start dr dc blockers grid)
      (let loop ([r (+ (first start) dr)] [c (+ (second start) dc)] [acc (list)])
        (cond [(not (in-bounds? r c (rows grid) (cols grid))) acc]
              [(member? (list r c) blockers) acc]
              [else (loop (+ r dr) (+ c dc) (append acc (list (list r c))))])))
    (define (corner-distance2 obj corner)
      (+ (abs (- (+ (obj-r1 obj) (obj-r2 obj)) (* 2 (first corner))))
         (abs (- (+ (obj-c1 obj) (obj-c2 obj)) (* 2 (second corner))))))
    (define (corner-index corner h w)
      (cond [(equal? corner (list 0 0)) 0]
            [(equal? corner (list 0 (- w 1))) 1]
            [(equal? corner (list (- h 1) 0)) 2]
            [else 3]))
    (define (shortest-path grid start goal allowed-colors)
      (let ((prev (make-hash)) (seen (make-hash)))
        (define (rebuild cur acc)
          (if (equal? cur #f) acc (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons cur acc))))
        (hash-set! seen start #t)
        (hash-set! prev start #f)
        (let bfs ([queue (list start)])
          (cond [(empty? queue) (list)]
                [(equal? (first queue) goal) (rebuild goal (list))]
                [else
                 (let* ((cur (first queue))
                        (next-queue
                         (for/fold ([q (rest queue)]) ([d (in-list dirs4-ordered)])
                           (let ((rr (+ (first cur) (first d))) (cc (+ (second cur) (second d))))
                             (if (and (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                      (not (hash-has-key? seen (list rr cc)))
                                      (member? (at grid rr cc) allowed-colors))
                                 (begin
                                   (hash-set! seen (list rr cc) #t)
                                   (hash-set! prev (list rr cc) cur)
                                   (append q (list (list rr cc))))
                                 q)))))
                   (bfs next-queue))]))))
    (define (first-appearance-palette grid)
      (let loop ([positions (grid-positions grid)] [seen (list)])
        (if (empty? positions)
            seen
            (let* ((p (first positions)) (v (at grid (first p) (second p))))
              (if (or (= v 0) (member? v seen))
                  (loop (rest positions) seen)
                  (loop (rest positions) (append seen (list v))))))))

    (let* ((tl-key (at g 0 0)) (tr-key (at g 0 (- (cols g) 1)))
           (bl-key (at g (- (rows g) 1) 0)) (br-key (at g (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
           (shape (crop-nonzero (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell (set-cell g 0 0 0) 0 (- (cols g) 1) 0)
                                                    (- (rows g) 1) 0 0)
                                           (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1) 0)))
           (top (pack-gallery (list (transform-by-key shape tl-key) (transform-by-key shape tr-key)) 1 'top))
           (bot (pack-gallery (list (transform-by-key shape bl-key) (transform-by-key shape br-key)) 1 'top))
           (w (max (cols top) (cols bot)))
           (top2 (paste-crop (empty-grid (rows top) w 0) top 0 0))
           (bot2 (paste-crop (empty-grid (rows bot) w 0) bot 0 0)))
      (append top2 (list (make-list w 0)) bot2))
  ))
